messages.author: 6eec351ad1d5a711
messages.subject: runMCMC causing unexpected crash
parts:
Morning, 
Not sure if anyone else has come across this issue, I have recently updated R, Rtools, Rstudio and Nimble and now when running some code which includes a runMCMC command the R session terminates with a pop up saying that the previous R session was abnormally terminated due to unexpected crash.  Other nimble functions work up until the point where I use the runMCMC command, the only line in the console window that appears is 'running chain1' and then it crashes. I have tried running the exact same model etc with the cMCMC$run(niter) command and it works fine. Any ideas??? This same issue occurs whether Im running Rstudio on my local machine or on our departments Rstudio server (which I obviously havent updated!) The same code had worked fine last week?!

Many thanks
Dave

messages.author: 6eec351ad1d5a711
messages.subject: Re: runMCMC causing unexpected crash
parts:
Hi Daniel,

Sorry I have fixed the issue... spot the obvious mistake (which I failed to do at 6am this morning)

runAF<- runMCMC(cCJSbuilt, niter=100, nburnin = 5000, nchains = 1, progressBar = TRUE, summary = TRUE, samplesAsCodaMCMC = TRUE)

I was just wanting to do a quick test run, had used the same code to run a much longer run so just removed a few zeros from niter... but just didnt see nburnin!
So sorry... really thought I had explored all options and it coincided with me updating everything! No wonder it had a melt down!

Loving Nimble, thank you!

messages.subject: Re: runMCMC causing unexpected crash
parts:
Dave, thanks for the follow up.  I'm glad you were able to spot it without any more headaches.

On this end - I just added a few checks in the MCMC, so that cases like this (where niter < nburnin) will instead give a helpful error message.  This will be included in the next updated package release.

Cheers,
Daniel
